title: Palindrome Check
statement:
Decide whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring
punctuation, spaces and letter case.

## Your function

```
int is_palindrome(const char *s);
```

Return `1` if it is a palindrome, `0` if it is not.

## Watch out

- Only letters and digits are compared. Everything else is skipped,
  which is why `A man, a plan, a canal: Panama` counts.
- Comparison is case insensitive.
- The empty string is a palindrome.
- Walking one index in from each end is enough; you do not need to
  build a cleaned-up copy of the string.
